options.command: mkdir -p "${PERF_OUTPUT_DIR:-perf-results}" && for PERF_VUS in 1 5 10; do for PERF_REPEAT in 1 2 3; do PERF_PROFILE=compare PERF_RUN_LABEL="${PERF_RUN_LABEL:-comparison}" PERF_OUTPUT_DIR="${PERF_OUTPUT_DIR:-perf-results}" PERF_VUS=$PERF_VUS PERF_REPEAT=$PERF_REPEAT k6 run --out "json=${PERF_OUTPUT_DIR:-perf-results}/${PERF_RUN_LABEL:-comparison}-vus${PERF_VUS}-run${PERF_REPEAT}-raw.json" tools/performance/service-benchmark.js || exit $?; done; done && node tools/performance/summarize-results.mjs "${PERF_OUTPUT_DIR:-perf-results}" "${PERF_RUN_LABEL:-comparison}"

mkdir -p "${PERF_OUTPUT_DIR:-perf-results}" && PERF_PROFILE=production-read PERF_RUN_LABEL="${PERF_RUN_LABEL:-production-read}" PERF_OUTPUT_DIR="${PERF_OUTPUT_DIR:-perf-results}" k6 run --out "json=${PERF_OUTPUT_DIR:-perf-results}/${PERF_RUN_LABEL:-production-read}-raw.json" tools/performance/service-benchmark.js && node tools/performance/summarize-results.mjs "${PERF_OUTPUT_DIR:-perf-results}" "${PERF_RUN_LABEL:-production-read}"
